WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes
  FROM status_counts
),
status_with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.powerstatus,
    sc.telescope_count,
    sc.telescope_count * 100.0 / tc.total_telescopes as share_percent
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share_percent) as avg_share
  FROM status_with_share
),
above_average_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sws.telescope_count,
    sws.share_percent,
    av.avg_share
  FROM status_with_share sws
  CROSS JOIN average_share av
  WHERE sws.share_percent > av.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
  AVG(share_percent) as average_share,
  AVG(share_percent - avg_share) as average_excess
FROM above_average_statuses
